description: Six original synthetic replacement/withdrawal workspace partitions across three people over two years, each carrying four months of relevant prior purchase/coverage/continuity/courier context. Every month is represented; lower repair frequency is intentional rather than inventing monthly phone failures.

provenance.author: Hanson Tang
provenance.website_anchor: Not applicable to the approved fictional MCP-only workspace; no real website data or account history is claimed.

seeds.description: Coverage inquiry; complete normal business episode.

records.body: Purchase proof (2025-01). Retained the dated purchase record and serial mapping in the private service folder; no passwords or recovery codes belong in a repair packet. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Ownership handover (2025-02). The household spare remains separately inventoried. A borrowed device does not transfer authority to wipe or surrender the owner’s work handset. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Backup rehearsal (2025-03). Restored a test contact to the spare device. Copied files and app icons do not certify an independent work login. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Coverage inquiry (2025-04). Checked which purchase document would be needed for a future eligibility decision; no replacement order or refundable hold was authorized. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.
2025-04: normal; the case closes only after the actual release posting. Serial-specific collection and manufacturer receipt are retained when a physical return was required.

seeds.description: Courier address review; complete pre-dispatch-withdrawal business episode.

records.body: Intermittent fault (2025-05). Recorded the intermittent charging symptom and an available spare before choosing whether the offered remedy was still needed. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Account separation (2025-06). Moved the proof-of-purchase copy into the owner’s folder. Employer authentication instructions remain in the private journal. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Travel contingency (2025-07). A planned trip narrows courier availability. A future return must use the actual serial and a slot whose booking and cancellation cutoffs remain open. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Courier address review (2025-08). Confirmed the fictional service address and delivery contact for future authorized collection; this note is not a booked pickup. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.
2025-08: pre-dispatch-withdrawal; the case closes only after the actual release posting. Serial-specific collection and manufacturer receipt are retained when a physical return was required.

seeds.description: Year-end inventory; complete shipped-withdrawal business episode.

records.body: Replacement inspection (2025-09). Recorded why the shipped remedy no longer suited the owner. Keeping the original requires returning the actual replacement, not sending the old device by habit. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Warranty document renewal (2025-10). Filed the updated coverage document after a household device purchase. Terms are synthetic; eligibility still comes from a case-specific provider offer. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Banking continuity rehearsal (2025-11). Checked that recovery instructions were available to the owner without sharing a one-time code. A future migration still needs performed exact-device login tests. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.

Year-end inventory (2025-12). Reconciled retained purchase proofs, owned serials and any manufacturer receipt already in the service folder. A courier handoff alone is not a manufacturer receipt. This is an original fictional service record, not observed manufacturer history.
2025-12: shipped-withdrawal; the case closes only after the actual release posting. Serial-specific collection and manufacturer receipt are retained when a physical return was required.
